scope: Actual resident agentctl: same-load dormant/thread/token/prefill isolation

rows.actions: scripted Native-parser choices; real agentctl/tool execution

method.residency: one model process; reset session only between independent tasks; no KV save/evict/restore
method.receipt: both off/on body-first then final status footer; default CLI legacy layout unchanged
method.workload: three real test.run calls plus four real Native prepare/first-greedy/actions through CLI REPL and AgentStore; fixed Native-parser tool choices;8 plain lines; actual words/iterations recorded on every row
method.order: One warmup per case/mode; seven evaluated repeats, rotating modes within each repeat. Prebuilt identical producer; no parallel benchmark/build/test.
method.metrics: CLI tick wall including tools, transcript assembly, Native and numeric logs; exact post-token independent tokenizer oracle measured separately and subtracted; raw wall retained
method.excluded: model load, helper first/warm execution, per-task ordinary Native reset; no build optimization
method.cpu_observation: Per-Native-prepare RUSAGE_SELF CPU includes parallel runtime workers and may exceed wall; owner CLOCK_THREAD_CPUTIME_ID is CPU only. Neither is GPU time. Decode/evaluated tokens recorded; all observers common. Producer main wall/CPU and private numeric sidecar as E33; child end precedes sidecar IO/exit.
method.policies: Same exit-race correction throughout. idle-race creates dormant consumer; thread-race same growth gate/owner no-op; token-race suffix tokenizer only; progress-race real eager consumer; lazy-race same growth gate, launch consumer only on first eligible output. off-race disables consumer. Default unchanged.

limits: One M5/Metal/Qwen0.6B; real CLI/tool execution, not autonomous model planning or full output generation
Tools bounded retained4096 bytes; test.run(empty args) and verified Qwen3 template only; full render/prefix guard remains
No snapshots, evictions, disk-KV transfer, memory capacity win, cloud SSE or Windows/CUDA acceptance
No evaluation tuning; all warmup/evaluation pairs and negative results retained; per-task reset/model-resident workload only
No GPU counters, CPU frequency or bandwidth observations; unchanged work with longer wall localizes phase but does not prove a GPU or scheduler cause.
No deletion of outliers. Whole-task mode differences are not additive pure-component costs or proof of indirect contention. Seven pairs do not establish stable tails.

default_regression.scope: Final source default C/HTTP/CLI; older E36 measured source independently archived

historical_not_rerun: Native14K and full Stream from E29; no rerun claimed
validation.lazy_scope: 13 existing unit cases plus five-policy actual CLI oracle
